captionPolicy: Burn in actual spoken words only, aligned to the received audio; do not invent transcripts.
mixPolicy: No voice-over during real clips; real clips at full level; optional music -24 dB and ducked under speech; final mix about -16 LUFS.
durationPolicy: Stage 2 measures the supplied VO files, extends scenes that need more time and reports the revised duration and all section starts.
stage2Status: Final rendered with eight Avinash lines, real clip audio, and burned-in captions; no music supplied.
finalTimingPolicy: Exactly 1800 frames / 30 fps; approved revised VO 2 and 7, no clip or speech truncation.
